status: UNTESTED - design data for the implementation agent; not yet consumed by code
disclaimer: Planning and decision-support aid only. Output lists investigations and authorities to IDENTIFY AND VERIFY. It is not engineering, legal or statutory approval and does not certify safety, constructibility, land availability or permissions.

evaluation.tristate: Each condition evaluates to true, false or unknown. An attribute that is missing, null or 'unknown' makes the condition unknown.
evaluation.all: all-block: false if any condition false; true if all true; otherwise unknown.
evaluation.any: any-block: true if any condition true; false if all false; otherwise unknown.
evaluation.emptyWhen: A rule with an empty 'all' list and no 'any' list matches on proposalType alone.
evaluation.firing: Rule result true -> investigations required, certainty 'requires_field_investigation' (or per investigation). Rule result unknown -> investigations STILL required, plus a data-gap finding with certainty 'unknown' naming the missing attributes. Rule result false -> rule does not fire; the finding that suppressed it keeps the certainty of the data used (e.g. 'verified_from_available_data').
evaluation.dedupe: Investigations required by several rules are listed once with all triggering rule ids and all sourceRefs.
evaluation.thresholdRef: 'threshold' names a key in thresholds; UI must show basis (statutory / authority_statement / hypothetical) next to any value used.

certaintyLabels.label: Verified from available data
certaintyLabels.meaning: A named dataset positively shows the fact (e.g. building polygon intersects footprint). Does not prove the dataset is complete.

certaintyLabels.label: Estimated
certaintyLabels.meaning: Derived by calculation from approximate inputs (e.g. buffer from a monument point instead of its protected limit).

certaintyLabels.label: Inferred
certaintyLabels.meaning: Reasoned from context, not measured (e.g. CRZ not applicable inland).

certaintyLabels.label: Unknown
certaintyLabels.meaning: No data. Never treated as clear or feasible.

certaintyLabels.label: Requires field investigation
certaintyLabels.meaning: Can only be established by survey/testing on site.

certaintyLabels.label: Requires professional assessment
certaintyLabels.meaning: Needs judgement and sign-off by a qualified professional or the statutory authority.

asiRegulatedM.note: 100 m prohibited + 200 m regulated (s.20B minimum); extendable

metroPlanningAuthorityM.note: Reported metro planning-authority extent either side of route; confirm

influenceZoneM.note: Screening default for building-impact buffer; actual zone to be set by geotechnical engineer (depends on depth, ground, method).

topographic_survey.name: Topographic and right-of-way survey
methods: overlay of DP road lines and city survey boundaries
standards: IRC:86-2018 (road widths, guidance only)

utility_survey.name: Existing utilities investigation
methods: Collect records from all utility owners
Ground penetrating radar (GPR) and electromagnetic locating
Trial pits/trenches to confirm depth and type
deliverables: Composite utility map with confidence level per line
standards: IRC:98 (accommodation of utilities in urban roads) to identify and verify
Indian standard for utility quality levels: not found (to identify and verify); ASCE 38 commonly referenced (to identify and verify)

tree_census.name: Tree census and impact survey
methods: Tree-by-tree census in and near footprint: species, girth, age, condition, heritage status
deliverables: Tree Authority application package (if felling unavoidable)
standards: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Act 1975, s.8 (permission); 2021 amendment (heritage trees, >200 trees) to identify and verify
authorities: Maharashtra State Tree Authority (large applications) to identify and verify

construction_traffic_plan.name: Construction staging and traffic diversion study
methods: Simulate diversion scenarios in this tool on frozen baseline demand
deliverables: Diversion plan with modelled impacts (model output, labelled)
standards: IRC:SP:43-2022 traffic management techniques to identify and verify
authorities: Pune City Traffic Police to identify and verify
Fire brigade/emergency services to identify and verify

geotechnical_investigation.name: Subsurface (geotechnical) investigation
methods: Boreholes with SPT/sampling in soil and core drilling in rock
Laboratory tests (index, strength, UCS on rock cores)
Geophysical survey (e.g. seismic refraction/ERT) to interpolate between boreholes
standards: IS 1892:2021 subsurface investigation for foundations to identify and verify
IRC:78 (Part 1)-2024 / (Part 2)-2020 foundations to identify and verify
authorities: Project owner's engineer; MahaMetro if within 20 m of metro

geological_mapping.name: Geological mapping and rock mass classification
methods: Surface and borehole geological mapping (basalt flow units, vesicular/amygdaloidal zones, red bole, weathering, joints, faults/lineaments)
Bhuvan lineament layer as a prompt only
deliverables: Rock mass class distribution with uncertainty
standards: IS 13365 (Part 1):2025 RMR to identify and verify
IS 15026 (Part 1):2022 / (Part 2):2023 to identify and verify
IRC:SP:91-2019 geotechnical investigations chapter to identify and verify

groundwater_investigation.name: Groundwater investigation
methods: Dewatering and drawdown impact assessment on nearby wells and buildings
standards: IS 1892:2021 to identify and verify
authorities: CGWB/GSDA guidance to identify and verify

seismic_assessment.name: Seismic hazard input
methods: Confirm seismic zone and site class from current IS 1893 edition
Site-specific study if required by designer
standards: IS 1893 (current edition; Pune zone to identify and verify)

tunnel_engineering_studies.name: Tunnel engineering studies
methods: Excavation method study (conventional/NATM vs TBM vs cut-and-cover)
Ventilation and fire-life-safety concept, emergency egress spacing
standards: IRC:SP:91-2019 Guidelines for Road Tunnels to identify and verify
IS 15026 to identify and verify
authorities: Fire brigade to identify and verify

building_condition_survey.name: Building condition and settlement-risk assessment
methods: Pre-construction condition survey of buildings in zone of influence (photos, cracks, foundation type if known)
Instrumentation and monitoring plan (settlement points, tiltmeters, vibration monitors)
deliverables: Monitoring plan with trigger levels set by engineer
standards: No Indian code identified for damage categories (to identify and verify)
authorities: PMC building permission department to identify and verify

metro_interface.name: Metro interface and NOC
methods: Obtain MahaMetro alignment/structure records (depth, lining, viaduct foundations)
Apply for NOC before any investigation works (boreholes, trial pits) and before construction
Interface/impact study and monitoring of metro structure
standards: Metro Railways (Construction of Works) Act 1978 and UDCPR provisions as cited by MahaMetro to identify and verify
authorities: PMRDA / Line 3 concessionaire for Line 3 to identify and verify

metro_planning_check.name: Metro planning-authority check
methods: Confirm whether the site is within the metro planning-authority area (reported 500 m either side) and what permissions apply

hydrology_hydraulics.name: Hydrology and hydraulic study
standards: IRC bridge codes (IRC:5-2024, IRC:78) to identify and verify
IRC river training guidance (edition to identify and verify)

flood_line_verification.name: Flood-line verification
methods: Obtain certified blue and red flood-line plans from Water Resources Department
Overlay on proposal; import into this tool as a layer
deliverables: Flood-line overlay with source and date
standards: Irrigation Dept circular 21.09.1989; UDCPR reg. 3.1.3 (as quoted by NGT) to identify and verify

heritage_impact_assessment.name: Heritage Impact Assessment
methods: Measure distance from protected-area limit (not centroid)
Visual, structural and vibration impact on monument/listed building
deliverables: NOC application package (if within regulated area)
standards: AMASR Act 1958 as amended 2010, ss.20A/20B to identify and verify
UDCPR heritage regulation / DCPR-2017 cl.39 to identify and verify

land_acquisition_social.name: Land requirement, acquisition and social impact
methods: Plot-level land requirement from surveyed footprint
deliverables: Social impact and rehabilitation framework (by specialist)
standards: Applicable land acquisition law and DP/TDR mechanisms to identify and verify
authorities: District Collector to identify and verify

pavement_drainage.name: Pavement and drainage investigation
standards: IRC pavement and drainage guidelines to identify and verify

structure_design_basis.name: Structure design basis (bridge/grade separator)
standards: IRC:SP:90-2023 (grade separators)
IRC:92-2017 (interchanges)
authorities: Owner's proof consultant to identify and verify

geometry_access_study.name: Ramp geometry, clearance and frontage-access study
methods: Ramp landing locations vs junctions and frontage access
authorities: Traffic Police to identify and verify

railway_interface.name: Railway interface
deliverables: Railway approval package to identify and verify
standards: Railway standards to identify and verify
authorities: Indian Railways (Central Railway, Pune division) to identify and verify

environmental_screening.name: Environmental screening and applicability check
methods: Record facts deciding EIA applicability: road classification, length, additional RoW/land, built-up area, distance to protected/eco-sensitive areas
Noise, vibration, air-quality and construction-waste baseline
deliverables: EIA applicability note for authority confirmation (never a self-determination)
standards: EIA Notification 2006 as amended (items 7(f), 8) to identify and verify
authorities: SEIAA Maharashtra / MoEFCC to identify and verify

construction_impact.name: Construction disruption, noise and vibration assessment
standards: to identify and verify

traffic_data_collection.name: Traffic evidence for management measures
methods: Saturation flow and queue length observation
Bus dwell/bunching, parking accumulation surveys as relevant
deliverables: Measured dataset with provenance, imported into the Traffic Data Manager
standards: IRC:93-1985 signals to identify and verify
Indo-HCM 2017 (saturation flow, PCU, control delay LOS) to identify and verify
IRC:124-2017 / IRC:SP:43-2022 for bus priority to identify and verify
authorities: Pune City Traffic Police to identify and verify
PMPML (bus operator) for bus measures to identify and verify

flags.text: No physical investigation expected unless civil works are added (then R01 applies). Statutory notification mechanism to verify with Traffic Police.

rules.title: Underground works: geology, groundwater, tunnel engineering

flags.text: Underground conditions are unknown until investigated. The tool cannot state that a tunnel or underground road is safe or constructible.
Buildings within the (hypothetical) influence zone; settlement/vibration risk requires professional assessment.

rules.title: Within 20 m of metro viaduct or tunnel

flags.text: MahaMetro NOC needed before any works, including boreholes/geotechnical study and utility laying (as reported Apr 2026). Sequence: metro NOC -> investigation -> design.

rules.title: Near or crossing a water body

flags.text: River corridor: blue/red flood-line status must be obtained from the Water Resources Department.

UDCPR reg. 3.1.3 (as quoted by NGT, Feb 2026) prohibits construction between river bank and blue line except listed uses; applicability to roads/bridges has been argued case-by-case. To verify with WRD and PMC.

rules.title: Between blue and red flood lines (restrictive zone)

flags.text: Restrictive zone: UDCPR 3.1.3 permits construction at 0.45 m above red flood line level (buildings); treatment of roads/structures to verify.

rules.title: Within ASI prohibited area (<=100 m of protected limit)

flags.text: NMA: no construction, including Government/public works, permitted in the prohibited area (AMASR as amended 2010). Prohibited area is understood to extend below ground (to verify) - relevant for tunnels. Consider alternatives.
Permission via ASI/NMA Competent Authority required for construction in regulated area.
PMC Heritage Committee consultation (DCPR-2017 cl.39 / UDCPR heritage regulation) to verify. Buffer is a hypothetical screening value.

rules.title: Foundations with no site geotechnical data

flags.text: Soil/rock conditions unknown. Pune is broadly Deccan Trap basalt with alluvium near rivers (CGWB) - not site-specific.

rules.title: Deep excavation with no groundwater data

flags.text: Tree Authority permission under s.8 of the 1975 Act applies to government bodies too. Large felling (>200 trees, per 2021 amendment excerpt) referred to State Tree Authority - verify.
Land availability cannot be established from maps. Ownership, acquisition and rehabilitation require land records and professional assessment.
Consider whether the diagnosed cause is addressable by management measures first.
Check whether downstream junctions can absorb the added flow (simulate with frozen demand).

rules.title: Utilities known only from records or not at all

flags.text: Utility positions are not verified; GPR/EM locating and trial pits required.
